record.question: Cultivation of Mulberry in 90 × 90 cm spacing of S1635. Cost benefit ratio is
record.explanation: For mulberry variety S1635 at 90×90 cm spacing (a closer, high-density planting), sericulture extension literature commonly cites a cost-benefit ratio of 1:4 for improved high-yielding varieties under good management. S1635 is an improved variety developed for higher leaf yield, and the 90×90 cm spacing optimizes per-hectare productivity, typically yielding a 1:4 ratio in CSB/state department package-of-practices.
